''See also: [[Yerin's master Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Yerin]]'s master was a powerful individual known as the [[Sword Sage]]. A handsome man in his early thirties with blond hair, he was often depicted wearing fine blue silk robes. As a [[Sage]], he occupied a rare and prestigious position in the world of [[sacred arts]], as such masters seldom take on disciples. He was a practitioner of the [[Path of the Endless Sword]] and specifically traveled to the [[Heaven's Glory]] for certain purposes. His training was rigorous and focused on the true costs of the [[sacred arts]], often avoiding lengthy explanations in favor of practical application. He left behind a legacy for his [[disciple]], [[Yerin]], including a white-bladed [[sword]] that is unnaturally cold and a solid [[gold badge]] featuring a [[sword]] emblem. Following his death, [[Yerin]] has sought to utilize his [[Remnant]]—a silver-colored mass of power that manifests as a ghost-like entity with six bladed limbs—to gain fragments of his wisdom and refine her combat techniques.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The character shares a connection with her student, [[Yerin]]. This bond is defined by the master's status as the most powerful [[sacred artist]] [[Yerin]] has ever encountered.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|As a [[Sword Sage]], she is recognized as the most powerful [[sacred artist]] [[Yerin]] has encountered. Her techniques include the use of a [[Steelborn body]] and she possesses pills capable of regrowing limbs. Additionally, she carries a [[Remnant]] sealed within her core.}}
